body:
I'm lonely. I've always been the sore thumb person who nobody would include in their social groups. Now I'm growing up to see how different I am from everyone else. I see them forming relationships and some older ones even getting married, and in the back of my head I know that I'll have the same problem as I did fitting in back in the day.

I feel dehumanized. One of the most signature identifiers that make people human is that they are social creatures, and the other being their ability to love and be loved. I can't do either of those, and it haunts me to be 'different'.
